purpose: Express confusion between two possible states.
keywords: Plain clause + のやら … + のやら
The reply is vague; I cannot tell whether it is agreement or opposition.
I cannot tell whether he is sleeping or thinking.
I cannot decide whether it is convenient or inconvenient.
formation: Plain clause + のやら … + のやら
mistake: The speaker is unsure which applies; both are not asserted as facts.
